about: Yuzuri's features, each with the switches serve.py sets to turn it off (off), the optional hooks it leaves out (hooks_off), the features it needs and the recipe's tier-1 patch it stands for (recipe: a name serve.py also takes). serve.py --features / --without pick them; every feature is on by default. --features base keeps on only the ones marked base: kernels, loading and fixes that lend and move no memory.

features.name: kv-vmm
features.for: the KV pool on remappable memory, pages mapped as used

features.name: stream-prefill
features.for: a prompt's experts streamed to the GPU from kt-kernel's arenas

features.name: prefill-lend
features.for: the GPU-resident weights' VRAM lent to a streamed prefill

features.name: kv-lend-plan
features.for: the KV pool's free pages lent to the prefill, each request's chunk planned

features.name: swa-lend
features.for: a hybrid sliding-window pool sized for the plan and lent outside prefill

features.name: hot-lend
features.for: the pool's free pages hold more experts on the GPU, following the routing

features.name: host-kv
features.for: the pool at the model's context, the rows past the card in host memory

features.name: cutile-nvfp4
features.for: NVFP4 GPU experts on FlashInfer's cuTile MoE from the checkpoint's bytes

features.name: cpu-gpu-overlap
features.for: the CPU hand-off packed by one kernel, the shared expert after the CPU request

features.name: host-allreduce
features.for: all-reduce through host memory (two cards without peer access)

features.name: live-topk
features.for: the sparse-attention indexer's top-k selected while the scores are made

features.name: rope-tables
features.for: the RoPE tables mapped as the context grows

features.name: embed-on-host
features.for: the token embedding read from pinned host memory

features.name: mm-on-demand
features.for: a multimodal model's encoder in host memory, on the card while it runs

features.name: fp8-decode
features.for: decode-sized block-FP8 GEMMs on their own kernels

features.name: gpu-moe-fp32
features.for: MXFP4 and Marlin GPU experts in fp32 between the GEMMs

features.name: loading
features.for: the loader skips what the CPU experts hold and reads ahead

features.name: stream-mmq
features.for: streamed groups through llama.cpp's int8 kernels

features.name: expert-cache
features.for: CPU experts cached in the node's free memory

features.name: hicache
features.for: HiCache's write-back staging buffer capped (HiCache itself is --server-arg)

features.name: prefill-warmup
features.for: prefill warmups before the server reports ready

features.name: swa-checkpoint-tail
features.for: prefix cache hits past a chunk boundary

always.name: thinking-default
always.for: a request without the thinking toggle takes SGLANG_DEFAULT_THINKING

always.name: shared-experts-unfused
always.for: no shared expert fused into a routed MoE that KT serves on the CPU

always.name: load-timeout
always.for: the barrier after an unbalanced load from SGLANG_UNBALANCED_LOAD_TIMEOUT_S

always.name: cutlass-kt-expert-count
always.for: the MXFP4 CUTLASS method under kt-kernel

always.name: pool-swa-guard
always.for: a sliding-window pool that seats no request stops the launch

always.name: placement
always.for: expert placement from --placement, KT_ROUTING_DUMP records routes

always.name: launch-timing
always.for: load timing when KT_LAUNCH_TIMING is set

always.name: gguf-lend
always.for: the lends on a GGUF pack, by the checkpoint's format
